sentences.text:
This Criminal Petition Is Filed vs Public Prosecutor For The on
21 July, 2020
Author: K.Suresh Reddy

Bench: K.Suresh Reddy
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Suresh Reddy
 Criminal Petition No. 2670 of 2020
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed, under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, to quash the proceedings against the petitioners - accused in Crime No.159 of 2020 on the file of Denduluru Police Station, West Godavari District, for the offences under Sections 270, 273 & 328 IPC r/w 34 IPC and Section 22 of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Prohibition, Advertisement and Regulation, Trade, Production Supply and Distribution Act, 2003 and Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: Denduluru Police Station, West Godavari District
entities.label: ORG

entities.text: Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Prohibition, Advertisement and Regulation, Trade, Production Supply and Distribution Act, 2003
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Public Prosecutor for the respondent-State.
Both the counsel would agree that this matter is squarely covered by an order of a learned Single Judge of this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch.
The same was also followed in Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019.

In view of the fact that this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners in Crime No.159 of 2020 on the file of Denduluru Police Station, West Godavari District, for the offences under Sections 270, 273 & 328 IPC r/w 34 IPC and Section 22 of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Prohibition,
Advertisement and Regulation, Trade, Production Supply and Distribution Act, 2003 and Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, are hereby quashed.
As a sequel, the Miscellaneous Applications, if any pending shall stand closed.
